To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 50 mum thick film ultrasonic transducers can be fabricated by using sol-gel spray coating, tape casting, and screen printing techniques.
thick films of piezoelectric materials can be fabricated and poled by the sol-gel spray coating, screen printing, and tape casting techniques.

the piezoelectric thick films have been successfully fabricated using sol-gel spray and tape casting methods, and the films have been characterized in terms of their electrical and mechanical properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of piezoelectric thick film on flexible stainless steel substrate for ultrasonic transducer application.
the fabrication and characterization of piezoelectric thick films.
the development and fabrication of thick film piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the sol-gel spray method is the most effective for making piezoelectric films.
all three fabrication methods are capable of producing piezoelectric thick films with a relative dielectric constant in the range of 100 to 130.
the sol-gel spray method produced the best results.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sol-gel sprayed and screen printed films are more promising for the fabrication of thick film piezoelectric transducers.
the sol-gel technique is the best for the piezoelectric films, the screen printing is the second best and the tape casting is the least suitable.
the sol-gel spray and tape casting techniques were more effective in fabricating thick film piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers than screen printing.

the piezoelectric thick films have the potential for use as high temperature ultrasonic transducers for NDE of materials and structures.
the sol-gel spray films are the most promising for piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers.
